lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Forge has been lit twenty years. Longer than that if you count my mother's, and I do.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Okonkwo. God. Sit down before somebody sees you standing.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Kell sent rifles. Actual rifles, down an actual road, to actual people. Twenty years I've been told nobody would.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Stronghold fell in the spring. We took forty of them in and buried nine. That's what Kell is to us now: nine holes and forty mouths.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Hale's out at the Basin on a ridge. Tell him the forge is still lit, he'll know what it means.
